winner_reason: Apple’s first major wave of on-device “Apple Intelligence” across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS will ship to hundreds of millions of users, making general-purpose assistants and generative tools a default OS layer. It has the broadest real-world impact, strong long-tail SEO value for explainers and how-tos on Apple’s AI stack, and despite being in the repeat 'Models' bucket, still edges out other stories on final score.
